mapper.sql: role_groups.*, DATE_FORMAT(role_groups.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(role_groups.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM `groups` AS role_groups LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = role_groups.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = role_groups.modified_by
WHERE role_groups.is_active = 1 AND role_groups.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users INNER JOIN user_groups ON user_groups.user_id = users.id WHERE users.is_active = 1 AND user_groups.group_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( sys_code, name, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( MD5(NOW()), #{role.name}, NOW(), #{role.createdBy}, #{role.isActive} )
DELETE FROM user_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId}; INSERT INTO user_groups (user_id, group_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId});
mapper.select: SELECT *, name AS nameOther FROM module_types WHERE status = 1 AND id IN ( SELECT (SELECT module_type_id FROM modules WHERE id = module_id) FROM permissions WHERE group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM user_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId}) )

SELECT * FROM module_types WHERE status = 1 AND id IN ( SELECT (SELECT module_type_id FROM modules WHERE id = module_id AND type = 'VIEW') FROM permissions WHERE group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM user_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId}) )
